name: product-brainstorm
description: Open brainstorm on onboarding drop-off. Exercises mindmaps: loose branching ideas, little structure, ideas that get clustered late.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: So sixty percent of signups never reach the second screen. I want ideas, no filtering yet.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: The first screen asks for a company name and a team size before it shows anything. That is a wall.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: So one direction is just ask for less. Defer everything we can.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Or ask for nothing. Let them into a sandbox workspace with fake data and only ask when they want to save something.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: I like that. The other thing is we have no idea what they are trying to do. A picker on screen one, are you here to do X or Y, might let us skip half the setup.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: Intent capture, okay.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Templates fall out of that. Pick your use case, get a workspace already populated for it.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: Import is the other one. If they come from a competitor, let them drag in an export file and we build the workspace from it.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: That is a big build though.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: No filtering yet, you said.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: Fair.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: What about the email verification step? We block on it and the mail takes up to a minute to arrive.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: Let them in unverified and verify in the background. Only gate on invite and billing.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: Okay that might be the single cheapest one on this list.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Social login too. We only do email and password.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: Google covers most of our segment.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: Anything on the measurement side? Because I am fairly sure we cannot see where in the screen they bail.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: We cannot. There is one event for signup started and one for workspace created and nothing in between.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: Field level events then. And a session replay on the signup flow for a week.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: Right. Let me try to group these. There is reduce the ask, which is defer fields, sandbox, no verification gate. There is guide the ask, which is intent picker and templates. There is import. And there is instrumentation.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Social login sits under reduce the ask I think.

utterances.speaker: Marc
utterances.text: And instrumentation is not really a fix, it is what tells us which of the other three to do.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: So instrumentation goes first regardless. Then we pick.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Unverified signin is cheap enough that I would just do it alongside.

utterances.speaker: Ines
utterances.text: Agreed. Instrumentation plus unverified signin this sprint, decide the rest when we can see the drop point.
